
```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt

# file locations ([source](https://github.com/ravel-lab/MTMG_longitudinal))
DGE_RESULTS="MT_MG_KEGG_DGE.csv"
METAG_SUMMARY = "MG_summary_glcorr.txt"
METAT_KEGGS = "MT_UMD_KEGGsums.txt"

# KEGGS for riboflavin genes
keggs = {
    "ribA/ribBA" : ["K01497","K14652"],
    "ribD" : ["K01498", "K00082","K11752"],
    "FMN hydrolase" : ["K22912", "K20860", "K20861", "K20862", "K21063", "K21064"],
    "ribB/ribBA" : ["K02858", "K14652"],
    "ribH" : ["K00794"],
    "ribE" : ["K00793"],
    "ribF" : ["K20884", "K22949", "K11753"]
}

def retrieve_rib_match(x):

    for k in keggs:
        if x in keggs[k]:
            return k
    return None


df = pd.read_csv(DGE_RESULTS)\
    .rename(columns={"Unnamed: 0" : "KEGG_ko"})
df_metagenomes = pd.read_table(METAG_SUMMARY)


df["rib_gene"] = df.KEGG_ko.apply(lambda x: retrieve_rib_match(x))

df_rib = df[~df["rib_gene"].isna()]


reads = pd.read_table(METAT_KEGGS).set_index("KEGG")
rel_reads = reads/reads.sum()

rel_reads = rel_reads.reset_index()
rel_reads["rib_gene"] = rel_reads["KEGG"].apply(lambda x: retrieve_rib_match(x))
rel_rib = rel_reads[~rel_reads.rib_gene.isna()]



samplenames = [c for c in reads_rib.columns if not c in ["KEGG", "rib_gene"]]

M = rel_rib.drop(columns='rib_gene')\
    .set_index("KEGG").T\
        .reset_index()\
            .rename(columns={"index":"UID"})


mgmt = M.merge(df_metagenomes)


kegg_numbers = [c for c in mgmt.columns if c.startswith("K0") or c.startswith("K1")]
kegg_numbers.extend(["UID", "CST", "Stability"])
mgmt_long = mgmt[kegg_numbers].melt(id_vars=["UID","CST","Stability"])
mgmt_long["rib_gene"] = mgmt_long["variable"].apply(lambda x: retrieve_rib_match(x))

# Limit to CST I, III and IV
mgmt_long = mgmt_long[mgmt_long.CST.isin(["I", "III", "IV"])]
mgmt_long.to_excel("MT_gene_counts_rib.xlsx")

alt.Chart(mgmt_long).mark_circle(size=8).encode(
    x=alt.X("value:Q", axis=alt.Axis(format=".1e")).title("Relative abundance"),
    y="CST:N",
    yOffset="jitter:Q",
    color="CST:N"
).facet(
    facet="rib_gene:N",
    columns=3
).transform_calculate(
    jitter="sqrt(-2*log(random()))*cos(2*PI*random())"
).resolve_scale(
    x="independent"
)


```

```{python}

df_rib["xline"] = 0
df_rib["yline"] = -np.log10(.05)

df_rib["Comparison"] = df_rib["Comparison"].str.replace("_", " vs CST ")
df_rib["Comparison"] = "CST " + df_rib.Comparison

points = alt.Chart().mark_point().encode(
    x=alt.X("MT_FC:Q").title("Fold Change"),
    y=alt.Y("MT_p_log10:Q").title("-log10(P-value)"),
    color = "KEGG_ko_named:N"
).transform_calculate(
    MT_p_log10="-log(datum.MT_p)",
    KEGG_ko_named="datum.KEGG_ko + ' - ' + datum.rib_gene"
)

vertical = alt.Chart().mark_rule(color="grey",strokeDash=[3,5]).encode(
    x="xline:Q"
)
horizontal = alt.Chart().mark_rule(color="grey", strokeDash=[3,5]).encode(
    y="yline:Q"
)

(points+vertical+horizontal).facet(
    column="Comparison",
    data=df_rib, 
    title="DGE of riboflavin genes between CSTs"
)

df_rib.drop(columns=["yline","xline"]).to_excel("DGE_rib_genes.xlsx",index=False)
```
